home.title: Welcome
home.subtitle: Choose your language to check in.

setup.title: Kiosk setup
setup.intro: Staff only: sign this kiosk in with its device ID and secret.
setup.invalid: Enter a device ID and a secret of at least 16 characters.
setup.failed: The kiosk could not be signed in. Check the ID and secret.

checkin.title: Check in
checkin.failed: We couldn't find a match. Please try again or see reception.
checkin.needsSetup: This kiosk is not signed in yet.
checkin.tapCard: Or tap your ID card on the reader.
checkin.cardNotFound: We could not find your record with this card. Please use the keypad.
checkin.cardReception: Please go to the reception desk.
checkin.unreachable: The kiosk cannot reach the clinic system right now. Please try again, or ask at reception.

intake.title: Your visit
intake.firstQuestion: What is the main reason for your visit today?
intake.scaleHint: 0 means none, 10 means the worst you can imagine.
intake.failed: That did not go through. Please try again, or ask a nurse.
intake.voiceFailed: Voice is not working right now. Please tap or type your answer.

phone.title: Scan this code with your phone's camera
phone.expires: This code works for {seconds} more seconds.
phone.failed: The phone code is not available right now. Please continue here.
phone.handedOver: Continued on your phone. This screen will now clear.

vitals.title: Your vital signs
vitals.skinTone: Pulse oximeter: warns about known skin-tone limits
vitals.noSession: Check in first to measure your vital signs.
vitals.failed: The vitals device could not start. Please ask a nurse.

guide.placeFinger: Place your finger on the demo sensor
guide.instructions: Rest a finger as shown, then start the demonstration. Keep still for about 10 seconds while the example readings appear.
guide.touchIdNote: These are generated demo readings. Mac Touch ID cannot measure pulse, oxygen, blood pressure or temperature; no physical sensor is accessed.
guide.failed: We could not save a new demo reading. Your visit is safe. Retry, or continue without the demonstration.
guide.automatic: Your readings are saved automatically. The next screen opens when the demonstration finishes.
guide.noCuff: Blood pressure is not included in this demo setup.

stages.position: Keep your finger comfortably in place
stages.saving: Waiting for the saved demo readings…

guide.alreadySaved: Your registration is already saved. Please ask reception if any details need changing. Returning to the health check keeps the same visit.

done.title: Thank you
done.seat: Your information is with the care team. Your next step will appear here.
done.waiting: We will call your number soon.

child.title: Who is the patient?
child.failed: Something went wrong. Please try again, or ask at reception.
child.nurseCheck: A nurse will check your child's temperature and breathing.
child.nurseTold: A nurse has been told. Please stay here.

consent.title: Before we start
consent.camera: Optional: show a local camera preview. No images or video are saved or sent. This demo does not assess your condition from the camera.
consent.voice: If you speak your answers, your voice is turned into text on the clinic's own server. No recording is kept.
consent.dataUse: Your answers go to the clinic team and into your clinic record.
consent.decline: I don't agree to data use
consent.reception: Please go to the reception desk.
consent.saveFailed: Your choices were not saved. Please try again, or ask at reception.

experience.oneStep: A little about you. One step at a time.
experience.askReception: If you need a hand, please ask at reception.
experience.welcomeDescription: Tell us a little about your visit, so the clinic team can take it from here.
experience.welcomePrivacy: You choose how to share your information.

identify.title: Check in
identify.description: Use your keypad ID or tap your card.

share.title: Tell us about your visit
share.description: Answer a few questions in your own way.

experience.privacyIntro: Before you continue, choose how this kiosk may use your information.

privacyTitles.dataUse: Your answers, for your care team

experience.identityHint: Use the code given at reception. For this demo, use 100005. This is not an account password.
experience.patientIntro: Choose who you are checking in for today.
experience.answerHint: Choose an answer below, or use your own words.
experience.vitalsIntro: These readings are from a simulated device in this research prototype. You can also skip this step.
experience.doneWaiting: Your details are ready for the clinic team to review.
experience.statusUnavailable: We cannot refresh your queue status right now. Please ask at reception if you need help.
experience.entryHeading: How would you like to check in?
experience.kioskDescription: Tell us what brought you in. Our assistant helps prepare your visit for the care team.
experience.phoneDescription: Use your own phone to check in and continue the conversation.
experience.qrUnavailable: The phone code is unavailable right now. You can continue on this screen.
experience.languageHint: You can change your language above.
experience.stationUnavailable: Check-in is temporarily unavailable. Please ask a nearby member of staff, or try again.
experience.cloudPreviewStatus: Preview · Online check-in is not connected yet
experience.cloudPreviewPhoneStatus: Available when online check-in is connected.

titles.department: Where would you like to go?

descriptions.patient: Add a few details so reception can register your visit.
descriptions.department: Choose a department, or let reception help you decide.
descriptions.doctor: Select a preferred doctor, or choose any available clinician.
descriptions.visit: A little context helps the team prepare for your visit.
descriptions.review: Check your details before sending them to the hospital team.

reception.demoData: Research demo · use fictional patient details
reception.urgentTitle: Please tell reception now if you need immediate help.
reception.urgentDescription: Do not wait to finish this form. You can also select any symptoms below to include in your registration. These choices do not determine your clinical urgency.
reception.name: Full name
reception.existingCode: Already have a demo patient code? Use code check-in

paediatrics.title: Paediatrics
paediatrics.description: Care for children and young people

emergency.title: Emergency
emergency.description: Urgent concerns · speak to reception now

reception.directoryFailed: We could not load the department directory. Please try again, or ask at reception.
reception.anyDoctorDescription: Let reception assign the care team
reception.doctorNote: This is a preference, not a booked appointment. Reception will confirm the clinician who can see you.
reception.reasonPlaceholder: For example, a follow-up appointment, a skin concern, a new symptom, or a question for your doctor.
reception.reasonHint: Use your own words. You do not need to know a medical term.
reception.reviewNote: Your details go to the hospital team for review. A nurse confirms any clinical urgency; no appointment or diagnosis is being promised.
reception.submitFailed: Your registration could not be confirmed. Your details are still here. Please try again, or ask reception for help.
reception.patientRequired: Enter your name, age and sex to continue.
reception.visitRequired: Choose a visit type and add a short reason to continue.

identityEyebrows.who: CARE FOR YOU AND YOUR FAMILY

identityDescriptions.identity: Find your hospital record, or create a new patient profile.
identityDescriptions.who: You can check in for yourself or help someone else.
identityDescriptions.patient: Make sure these details describe the person receiving care.
identityDescriptions.ready: Our assistant will listen, ask relevant questions and prepare information for the care team.

reception.lookupConsent: I agree to the hospital looking up my record using these details.
reception.lookupHint: Use your details, or the patient’s ID if you know it. You can choose who needs care next. Demo patient: 100001, birth year: 1968.
reception.verificationHint: Confirm your birth year before we show your details.
reception.newPatient: I’m new here — register a new patient

identityResults.no_match: We could not find a matching record. Check the number, or register as a new patient below.
identityResults.unavailable: We cannot look up records right now. Try again, register a new patient, or ask a member of staff.
identityResults.verification_failed: We could not verify those details. Check the birth year and try again, or ask a member of staff.

self.title: Me
self.description: I am the person receiving care

child.title: My child
child.description: I am a parent or guardian

elder.title: An older relative
elder.description: I am helping an older family member

reception.verifiedDetails: These details came from a verified hospital record. Check that they belong to the person receiving care.
reception.dependentDetails: Enter the patient’s details below. Your details are kept separately as their helper.
reception.newDetails: Enter fictional details for this research demonstration.
reception.separateHistory: The helper’s medical history is not used as the patient’s history.
reception.optionalDepartmentHint: You do not need to choose a department. The care team can guide you after hearing about your visit.
reception.teamWillGuide: Let the care team guide me
reception.conversationNext: Next: Tell us what brings you in
reception.conversationDescription: Speak or type in your own words. The assistant asks follow-up questions based on what you tell it. You can review what has been captured before the care team takes over.
reception.privacySaved: Your privacy choices are saved for this visit. You can use touch and typing without camera or voice.
reception.privacyBeforeMedia: Choose your privacy preferences before the microphone or camera can be used.
reception.recordAvailable: Your verified patient record is available to support this visit.
reception.adaptiveFailed: We could not start the conversation. Your details are still here. Please try again or ask a member of staff.
reception.dependentRequired: Enter the patient’s name, age and sex, and the helper’s name. For a child, use an age under 16.
reception.immediateHelp: Please alert a nearby member of staff now if you need immediate help. You can keep checking in while help is arranged.
reception.adaptiveFirstQuestion: What is the main reason for your visit today?
reception.helpRecorded: Your urgent request has been saved
reception.helpFailed: The request could not be saved. Please alert reception now. You can retry or continue checking in.
reception.helpNotSent: No request has been sent yet. Sending it saves an urgent request for the care team without waiting for identity details.
reception.urgentIncluded: Your selected symptoms will be included when this visit is started. No request has been sent yet.
reception.savedDetailsDescription: These details have already been registered. Return to your conversation without starting another visit.
reception.urgentSymptomsOptional: Select any symptoms that apply, or request help without selecting one.
reception.urgentConsent: I agree to share this request and these symptoms with the care team.
reception.urgentSavedDescription: Your request is on the nurse worklist. This does not mean a clinician has acknowledged it. Use your visit reference when speaking to staff.
reception.urgentNoDelay: Tell the nearest member of staff now. You can continue, but do not wait for measurements before getting help.

holdToTalk.title: Voice answer
holdToTalk.hint: Press and hold this button, or hold the Space bar. Speak in the language you selected, then release. Up to 30 seconds per answer.
holdToTalk.privacy: Your microphone is off until you hold. Audio is processed locally and is not saved.
holdToTalk.tryAgain: Microphone setup stopped when you released. Hold again and speak when Listening appears.
holdToTalk.noSpeech: We did not hear a clear answer. Hold again, or type your answer.
holdToTalk.failed: Voice is unavailable right now. You can try again or type your answer.

cameraPreview.title: Camera preview
cameraPreview.description: Optional live preview, visible only on this screen. No video is saved or sent. It does not assess your condition.
cameraPreview.denied: Camera permission was not granted. You can continue without it.
cameraPreview.unavailable: The camera is unavailable. You can continue without it.

adaptiveIntake.intro: Tell us what is happening, in your own words. Your answers guide the next question.
adaptiveIntake.examplesHint: These are examples, not a list of conditions. Any reason for visiting is welcome.

onset.1: It started about two days ago.
onset.2: I am not sure when it started.

location.1: It is on the left / right side of my…

adaptiveIntake.processingHint: Your answer is saved only when the next question appears. Please keep this page open.

patientReceipt.title: Your visit, ready for the care team
patientReceipt.referenceHint: Keep this reference. Your queue token appears after the nurse reviews your visit.
patientReceipt.alertTitle: Priority alert recorded for the nurse

patientReceipt.notDiagnosis: This prototype suggestion is not a diagnosis or a decision to wait. A nurse confirms your priority.
patientReceipt.noSuggestion: A nurse will review your answers. No model suggestion is available yet.
patientReceipt.cameraStatus: Local preview only; no clinical assessment recorded
patientReceipt.unavailable: Your receipt could not refresh. Your saved visit is unchanged.
patientReceipt.warnings: Some information needs the nurse’s review.
patientReceipt.assistanceTitle: Urgent help request recorded for the nurse
